title: Kodak Ektralite 400 Camera - Reomar 24 mm - Electronic Flash - Untested
descriptionText: The Kodak Ektralite 400 Camera is a compact point-and-shoot camera known for its black color and 110 film format. With a 24mm lens and electronic flash capabilities, this camera is perfect for capturing moments on the go. The brand reputation of Kodak ensures quality and reliability in a compact and user-friendly design. While the item is untested, it holds the potential to produce stunning images with its film photography capabilities.
